fixes: Added a dedicated non-root CapEx batch image in Dockerfile.capex.
Added a repository .dockerignore without changing the generic Autarch image.

findings.summary: The root pyproject defines the CapEx optional dependency set and a supported Python range.
The CapEx CLI entry point, live and rules engines, sample ABBYY data, output generation, review command, documentation, and focused tests are present.
Dockerfile.capex packages the CapEx workflow and sample ABBYY data as a non-root finite batch container without changing the generic Autarch image.
Workflow state, reviews, dashboards, and audit files are stored under a local sandbox path that is ephemeral in a cloud container.
findings.fix: For the demo, mount persistent storage or export outputs to Blob Storage; for the target design, move work state and decisions to Azure SQL and immutable evidence to Blob Storage.

findings.summary: Reviewer names are attributed but are not authenticated identities.
findings.fix: Use Entra-authenticated reviewer identity before production use; keep the CLI attribution only for the controlled demo.

warnings.summary: Cloud container state would be ephemeral
warnings.detail: Case snapshots, review events, generated reports, and signed audit exports are currently written beneath the local workspace.
warnings.fix: Mount persistent storage or export demo outputs to Blob Storage; use Azure SQL plus immutable Blob Storage for the target architecture.

warnings.summary: The CapEx batch workflow has no HTTP health endpoint
warnings.detail: The generic Autarch CLI has a health command, but the CapEx workflow is a finite batch process rather than an HTTP service.
warnings.fix: Deploy it as a Container Apps Job for the demo and do not configure an HTTP health probe; add a service-specific readiness endpoint only if an API wrapper is introduced.

warnings.summary: Human reviewer identity is not authenticated
warnings.detail: The review CLI requires a name but does not verify that name against Microsoft Entra ID.
warnings.fix: Use Entra-authenticated reviewer identity and RBAC before production use.

detectedStack: Python 3.9+ CLI/batch workflow using Microsoft Agent Framework and Autarch

buildRequirements.f1BlockReason: The CapEx use case is a finite batch workload suited to Container Apps Jobs, not an App Service F1 web application.

postDeployRecommendations.title: Authenticate finance reviewers
postDeployRecommendations.reason: Production review decisions need a verified Entra identity rather than a typed reviewer name.

postDeployRecommendations.title: Externalize durable workflow state
postDeployRecommendations.reason: Local case, review, output, and audit files are not durable in a scale-to-zero container.
